title: Rafael and the Summer
author: Zephyrine Galloway
blurb: Silas Nystrom, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
